confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from thin, partly conflicting cost-of-living sources (2023-2026, mixed kip-to-USD conversions) plus tourist-area markup reasoning, so treat them as rough. Beer, coffee, meal, cocktail and wine anchors are bounded estimates; the cocktail is set at roughly 2.3x the beer anchor because no direct Vang Vieng cocktail price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied context, not based on inspected booking pages or current listings. The FX figure came from search-result summaries that quoted the RBA's 4.00 pm rate for 18 November 2026 and was not confirmed by opening the RBA table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Lao tourist-town pricing (Vang Vieng tourist-area markup over Vientiane and local shop prices, with Luang Prabang as a comparable tourist destination) and general knowledge of Southeast Asian backpacker-hub accommodation rates.
